meta.name: Elite Force
meta.description: After an unprecedented attack on his unit, a high-ranking officer set to leave the field leads a perilous mission that forces him to confront his past.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: David, a high-ranking GIGN officer, is preparing to leave field operations. But a new recruit's graduation and a shocking attack threaten his plans.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Devastated by the previous night's events and under new scrutiny, the squad tracks down a suspect. On a mission, Max disobeys a direct order from David.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: After the forest shootout, David pockets key evidence. Max continues to question his father's death, and a hospital visit takes an ominous turn.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Having linked the mastermind behind the attacks to an old operation, David goes on a rogue mission – but he's not the only one searching for answers.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: David faces the consequences of his actions. Brought in for questioning, he tries to protect Max, and finally tells his godson the whole truth.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: As news of a hostage situation reaches the squad, they race to launch a rescue mission and take down a skilled assassin who has nothing left to lose.
